nom: COSRX One Step Original Tone Clarifying Moisture Pad

avis.texte: These toner pads are super practical and gentle on the skin, especially for busy mornings or after the gym. I noticed a smoother skin after consistent use. Lightweight texture, hydrated finish instead of that tight feeling, and the results definitely meet expectations.
I absolutely love this product it's so clarifying and helps decrease the appearance of my dark under eyes!

avis.titre: POV: Your dark spots just met their match.
avis.texte: This is my first time using these and I love them. What stood out immediately is how many effective ingredients are in one pad ??Niacinamide, Alpha-Arbutin, Hyaluronic Acid, Glutathione, Squalane, and NMF. It really simplifies your routine.The pads are well-soaked but not dripping, and they glide across the skin without irritation. After the first use, my skin felt noticeably more hydrated and looked smoother.If you struggle with uneven tone, dryness, or dullness, this is a great all-in-one step. I'm continuing to use them daily to track long-term results. The dirt reveal was amazing to watch come off.

These are awesome! The amount of product on each pad is incredible! Each pad is saturated so i couldn't see them drying out easily. I love the tweezers on the top of the inside of the lid. I have 3 jars on these all in different colors and i love them all and use a specific one depending on how my skin is feeling that day. I have sensitive skin and some products easily burn but skin but i have had zero issues with these pads. My skin looks so glowy afterwards!
I love theses moisturizing pads! Anything by cosrx is amazing, these are no exception!

My skin is so juicy afterwards the results are moisture and glow. I did not have any breakouts from these pads. Their package is so cute prescription skin care I loved it makes it easy to remember to put them on.

So this is truly the best facial pads I've used they helped my breakouts to clear up and this is exactly the result your looking for when using this product so my skin feels amazing and hydrating and clear

Now I want to try the pink collagen one.
